entries.statement: When attacking an enemy with good compatibility, damage dealt is increased by 100%.
entries.quote: When attacking an enemy with good compatibility, the damage dealt is 100% UP .
entries.sourceTitle: 【The Grand Mafia Strategy | Formation Part 1】The Basics of Formations That Many People Get Wrong

entries.statement: When attacked by an enemy with good compatibility, damage received is decreased by 50%.
entries.quote: When attacked by an enemy with good compatibility, the damage received is 50% DOWN .
entries.sourceTitle: 【The Grand Mafia Strategy | Formation Part 1】The Basics of Formations That Many People Get Wrong

entries.statement: Troop compatibility determines victory or defeat unless there is a large difference in buffs.
entries.quote: unless there is a large difference in buffs, troop compatibility determines victory or defeat
entries.sourceTitle: 【The Grand Mafia Strategy | Formation Part 1】The Basics of Formations That Many People Get Wrong

entries.statement: Troop speed order from fastest to slowest is Bikers, Hitmen, Bruisers.
entries.quote: The speed is fastest in the order of Bikers → Shooters → Brawlers.
entries.sourceTitle: 【The Grand Mafia Strategy | Formation Part 1】The Basics of Formations That Many People Get Wrong

entries.statement: In The Grand Mafia's combat system, attacks are received the moment troops collide with the enemy after battle starts.

entries.sourceTitle: 【The Grand Mafia Strategy | Formation Part 1】The Basics of Formations That Many People Get Wrong

entries.statement: Hitmen attack from a distance, resulting in a fast attack start speed, allowing them to attack before the enemy.

entries.sourceTitle: 【The Grand Mafia Strategy | Formation Part 1】The Basics of Formations That Many People Get Wrong

entries.statement: Bikers have fast movement speed and quickly reach their target.

entries.statement: Bruisers have slow movement speed, are slow to reach the enemy, and have a delayed attack start compared to Bikers or Hitmen.

entries.sourceTitle: 【The Grand Mafia Strategy | Formation Part 1】The Basics of Formations That Many People Get Wrong

entries.statement: A small number of troops used as a wall prevent damage while moving towards the opponent.

entries.statement: In a Square Formation, the front row squads are the ones that receive attacks.
